Title: Patrologiae Cursus Completus, Series Latina, tomus LXXXVIII (Regula Magistri,
    Cresconius and other writers of the 7th-8th centuries)
Creator: The Master (anonymous author of the Regula Magistri, c. 500-530); Cresconius; and
    others (J.-P. Migne, compiler)
Publisher: Paris, Migne, 1862 (title leaf)
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: 1862 publication, out of US copyright by date; the item carries no copyright field of
    its own, so the imprint date is the basis, read directly 2026-10-23. The host's date
    field reads 1800 (a placeholder); the volume's own title leaf is dated 1862.
Language: lat
Source: Internet Archive item patrologiaecur88mign (archive.org/details/patrologiaecur88mign),
    fetched directly (curl, raw bytes) from the item's own _djvu.txt full-text file,
    2026-10-23, Library thread (Era III).
Provenance note: Raw, uncorrected djvu OCR (rough but readable). Runs of 2+ spaces collapsed to one; no
    wording changed. Sections: Migne columns; the Regula Magistri by chapter (caput) from
    raw line ~78482 (chapter form at ~82155). Credit line for a reader-facing page:
    "Patrologia Latina 88 (Migne, 1862)". Whole text republishable.
Content note: The Rule of the Master is the older rule that Benedict's Rule reworks, and survives in
    Latin only. The surrounding volume is mostly unrelated matter.
